diagram_previews.alt: Regular hexagon DANIEL with D and A at the bottom, N at the right, I and E at the top and L at the left. Sides LD and NA are extended downward as dashed lines meeting at F below side DA, forming an equilateral triangle FDA. The blue segment FE runs from F to the top-left vertex E. Sides DA, LE and DF are labelled 6.
